title: A comparison of methods for estimating the lactate threshold
publisher: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research
claims: The study compared four field methods with a laboratory lactate threshold assessment in 27 competitive distance runners and triathletes.
The 30-minute time trial and the VDOT method were as accurate as the laboratory assessment for estimating running speed at the lactate threshold.
The 30-minute time trial also provided an accurate and practical estimate of heart rate at the lactate threshold.
